prose.text: The block runs, in order: - the formatter and the linter; - the agent crate's unit suite (the literal, the word, the row's three readings, `counts`, `verified`); - the root bin's unit layer (verify's lines and settle, the gate's refusal at once, the rig's arms, seed, `cache-a`   and stamp lines, which are viola-e2e inline cases); - the changed integration binaries by name. `cli_verify` is in it: the fake's screens change (verification-harness.md   2026-11-17). `cli_send` holds the nothing-sent case, `contract_ledger_probes` and `cli_version_gate` read the   stamps, and `rig_rehearsal` holds the two new arms' rehearsals; - the whole integration and E2E layers: every stamped binary and the harness boot stamp 24 rows; - the live round of `BP` and `BK` (step 21).

What is not run, and why: - The release check: the new option lives in the test-only `viola-fake-agent` binary (`required-features =   ["fake-agent"]`) and the rig in the test-only `viola-e2e`, both already refused by `scripts/release-check.sh`. No   product code reads either (security standing S2). - No mutation run (`inputs#I1` item 8; testing.md 2026-10-04).

Waits and kills: - Every root test that waits keeps the shared 12 s `WITHIN` under the 20 s lint. - The verify-driven cases have no test-side bound: the `ci` 20 s kill is theirs (test-plan   `decision/verify-driven-tests-20s-kill`), and the `verify_window_` class keeps its 80 s. - No new settle is waited out: the browser-tools screen settles at once.
Test homes: every test start runs under a test-owned user home (testing.md 2026-11-18).
The operator pass: verify's output feeds the harness boot (`LEDGER_ROWS`), so the pass boots one session `screen-smoke`, reads its status and cleans it up (boot never piped).

The live leg's non-priming probes are the round entries ahead of it: the install read by path, the rig's census and the build's hash. None of them primes anything. The round's census after each leg is set out in step 23, for the whole round and for a resume at one entry.

The remove-the-guard controls are implement's one-shot `gate.py control` runs, not entries (validation.md check 4 (6)). Each is fired with the `--timeout` named below, on an entry whose build reaches every binary its case needs. «holds» means the named case ran and FAILED with no TIMEOUT line; a `timeout` reading is not «holds». Each id is at most 16 characters, and each case is named as nextest prints the NAME (testing.md 2026-11-14), copied from the first run. - `bt-literal` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/screen.rs`: the browser-tools literal removed from   `SIGNATURES.modals`; case `verdict_refuses_at_once_on_the_browser_tools_prompt`, fired on entry 4 (`run --unit`, a   workspace-building layer; testing.md 2026-11-13) with `--timeout 900`. With the guard gone the first verdict is a   wait, not `Done(InputNotReady)`. This is measured at implement. - `bt-absent` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`: the `absent` clause of `counts` removed; case   `verified_reads_the_browser_tools_row_absent_as_counting`, fired on entry 3 with `--timeout 600`. With the guard   gone the stamp reads unverified. This is measured at implement. - `bt-none` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`: the "none reads `none`" clause removed from the row's   reading; case `browser_tools_row_reads_fail_when_a_first_screen_reads_none`, fired on entry 3 with `--timeout 600`.   With the guard gone the row reads `absent`. This is measured at implement. - `bt-modalsig` — `crates/viola-agent-claude/src/ledger.rs`: `ModalSignature` reading the whole modal set again; case   `modal_signature_fails_on_a_browser_tools_screen_at_run_a`, fired on entry 3 with `--timeout 600`. With the guard   gone the row passes. This is measured at implement.
